name: ATM Service Type 12 Code
definition: Describes the type of inquiry selected by the customer or the ATM.

ASTS.name: Account Statements
ASTS.definition: Request a full statement (that is a legal statement) related to a customer account.

DCCS.name: Dynamic Currency Conversion
DCCS.definition: Ask to a DCC service provider to qualify the currency conversion for the card.

XRTD.name: Exchange Rate Deposit
XRTD.definition: Ask for exchange rate for the ongoing deposit transaction.

XRTW.name: Exchange Rate Withdrawal
XRTW.definition: Ask for exchange rate for the ongoing withdrawal transaction.

EMVS.name: Select EMV Application
EMVS.definition: Select the EMV applications allowed by the acquirer.

CMPF.name: Customer Profile
CMPF.definition: Ask for customer profile with eventualy related account information.

ACCD.name: Account Download
ACCD.definition: Download accounts associated to the customer card.

MINI.name: Mini Statement
MINI.definition: Request a mini-statement (i.e. partial statement) related to a customer account.
